comment: Attachment-only diagnostic for apply.c:fig_transform through an inventory-held cursed figurine; it does not establish callback runtime. The wizard setup uses wizcmds.c:wiz_intrinsic and 10000a to select the first menu property, invulnerable, and sets u.uinvulnerable's timeout to 10,000. C records rnd(9000)=3558 in timeout.c:attach_fig_transform_timeout, so start_timer receives 3,758 turns. The 4,000-repeat wait ends at zero-based step 70 with 'You stop waiting.' It never reaches the timer callback: timeout.c:nh_timeout returns while u.uinvulnerable is true before the intrinsic countdown loop and its later run_timers() call. The two separate callback records are recordings/apply.c/figurine-timeout-wizard-wish-a61-timer-callback.session.json and recordings/apply.c/figurine-timeout-wizard-wish-a61-timer-callback-seed-variation.session.json.
